title: Spark Structured Streaming: micro-batch and continuous

videos.script: Lesson 11 ended with a watermark you wrote yourself, in forty lines of Python. {{recap}} It worked. It also kept its state in memory, and a crash would have lost every window. {{crash}} This lesson hands that work to an engine. Spark Structured Streaming lets you write the count as if the sales were one big table. {{table}} Behind the query, Spark runs it again every few seconds, over only the rows that are new. Each run is a micro-batch. {{batches}} Three things decide what it does. The output mode says which rows leave after each batch. The trigger says when the next batch starts. The checkpoint says where to begin after a crash. {{three}} You will run the same five-minute count three ways, and stop it and start it again. {{runs}} By the end, you can read what Spark printed and say which batch produced each row, and why. {{end}}
